title: Claims-Ratio Multiplier on Pocketwire Business Profile Chargeback Fees
content:
**Standard of the risk pricing team.** The ratio-adjusted chargeback fee on a Pocketwire Business Profile starts from the chargeback fee level plus the claim reason surcharge. When the number of chargebacks dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date is more than the tier's chargeback ratio review threshold percent of the number of sales dated in that window, that sum is multiplied by 2. When it is more than half of that percentage but not more than it, the sum is multiplied by 1.5 and rounded up to whole dollars. Otherwise the sum is kept as it is. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Thresholds in figures

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chargeback ratio review threshold | 1.00% | 1.00% | 1.00% | 0.90% | 0.75% | 0.65% |
| Half of the threshold | 0.50% | 0.50% | 0.50% | 0.45% | 0.375% | 0.325% |

Columns are the tiers Pocketwire Business Starter to Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| Chargebacks as a percentage of sales in the rolling 3 months | Ratio-adjusted chargeback fee |
|---|---|
| more than the threshold | fee level plus surcharge, multiplied by 2 |
| more than half the threshold, not more than the threshold | fee level plus surcharge, multiplied by 1.5 and rounded up to whole dollars |
| half the threshold or less | fee level plus surcharge, as it is |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Pocketwire Business Starter, 200 sales in the window, fee level plus surcharge USD 25.00)

| Chargebacks | Ratio | Ratio-adjusted chargeback fee |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1.50% | USD 50.00 |
| 2 | 1.00% (not more than 1.00%) | 25.00 multiplied by 1.5 is 37.50, rounded up to USD 38.00 |
| 1 | 0.50% (not more than 0.50%) | USD 25.00 |
